multibook_rule: A_00 load_account_attributes (data/cot/scripts/gold/A_00.accounts_dimension.py:371-432) loads the single latest silver partition (the sorted-last key under silver/account_attributes/, :403) and reduces it to one row per account. At a multi-book account the three flag columns (account_supervised, account_billable, position_only) must agree across that account's rows: any disagreement raises SystemExit and refuses the build (:413-425). portfolio_group is not asserted: the dimension keeps the FIRST row's book in partition order (drop_duplicates keep='first', :432), and each multi-book account is printed as a NOTE (:426-430). join_account_attributes (:439-467) then left-joins that one-row-per-account frame onto the dimension by account_id.

partition_order_dependence.evidence: data/cot/scripts/gold/A_00.accounts_dimension.py:432 drop_duplicates(subset=['account_id'], keep='first') over the latest silver partition: the portfolio_group kept at a multi-book account is the first row in partition order. data/cot/scripts/silver/cot_silver_merge.py:489 dedups keep='first' and :498 writes the parquet with no sort, so partition order is the bronze row order.

partition_naming: silver/account_attributes/<data date>.parquet, where the data date is read from the xlsx Timestamps sheet, falling back to the YYYY-MM-DD in the bronze filename (cot_silver_merge.py:476-483, :496, :500). With a date (the SSM RunDate, passed as DATE_ARG at infra/aws/terraform/cot-pipeline/ssm.tf:237-238) one run reads only ACCOUNT_ATTRIBUTES_DAILY_<date>.xlsx (cot_silver_merge.py:533-553). With no date the run is incremental: it lists every bronze file and processes each whose etag is new or changed since the manifest (:559-577), so one run can read several bronze days. The table has no FORWARDFILL_QUARANTINE entry.
what_this_shows: One bronze pull (2026-10-15: 1127 rows, 1004 accounts) against the stale silver partition (2026-08-19: 943 rows, 942 accounts) shows 62 accounts added, none removed, and 171 of the 942 shared accounts changed in at least one of the four columns (130 portfolio-group, 45 billable, no supervised or position-only change). The bronze pull holds 122 accounts with more than one row, and none of them carries a supervised, billable or position_only disagreement.
not_established: Only one bronze day (2026-10-15) was measured; no other bronze day and no silver partition newer than 2026-08-19 exists or was measured.
The served gold dimension and its consumers were not read or run, so the effect on served numbers is not measured.
The live SSM document was not read; the plan check (AC2) reads one in-place change against the Terraform copy at HEAD, so whether the live document equals the held copy is not established.
The multi-book count is by raw bronze rows per account, not by distinct portfolio group.

Reader and writer classification is a grep of the four column names plus a read of the matching lines; a reader that reaches the columns under another name is not seen. Non-.py gold_validate_config.yaml is a config check, not a script, and is not counted.
